name: programbench
description: ProgramBench 1.0's tasks with a verifier allowlist (huggingface.co, cas-server.xethub.hf.co, us.gcp.cdn.hf.co, us.aws.cdn.hf.co, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org) and pytest-timeout pinned. Hidden tests that are missing or never report end unscored, never as a silent 0; test cases that reach the internet through the program under test aren't counted. 197 tasks: ogham__dog.721440b, hatoo__oha.8dc6349, raviqqe__muffet.a882908 and ekzhang__bore.8e059cd are left out (the program under test opens its own network connections; not gradable offline). Needs a BenchFlow release that enforces a task's verifier network allowlist.
